newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Further improvement questionable.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Further improvement questionable.

text.p: Despite another rise of 10 points in the BFI to 1,460 (up 45 for the week as a result of stronger panamax rates) and reports of more panamax period enquiry and chartering, some brokers believe that further improvement for owners is questionable.
Some brokers point to the failure on subjects of a number of panamax fixtures and the absence of fresh grain enquiry today, as well as continued weakness on the caper and handy-size markets.
However, period activity in panamaxes has been a strong feature of the latter part of this week.

NYK was said to have fixed Brazilian Venture 70,728 dwt delivery PMO end Feb for 12 months at $11,250/11,500 daily, and Halla booked Anaisai 73,200 dwt delivery UK end Feb redelivery Atlantic for the same period at $11,150 daily.
Goldbeam were linked with Nemea 68,870 dwt delivery China March 15/25 for about 6-8 months at close to $11,250 daily.

Italian charterers Premuda have been linked with Borzesti 64,854 dwt for 5-7 months, Irene Ve 81,796 dwt for 7-9 months, both delivery Atlantic, and Continental Spirit 65,224 dwt delivery La Spezia end Feb for unknown duration, but rates have not yet surfaced.
A number of charterers are in the market for periods up to 12 months timecharter but owners will have noted the quantity of period fixtures which have failed today on subjects.
Antonis I Angelicoussis 69,300 dwt delivery Japan early March for 2 months to Keoyang at $11,750 daily, and Achilles 68,779 dwt at the same rate and same period to Goldbeam.
Yukong are rumoured to have failed 3 panamaxes on subjects for period charters.
GRAIN - Few new orders were seen today, although Toepfer quoted 65,000 heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Lisbon for Feb 20/28 and 8,000/9,800 barley Rostock/Tobruk for Feb 21/28.

Meanwhile Glencore were believed to have fixed Niki 120,000 dwt on private terms for barley from N.France to Jeddah, and also booked tonnage for 50/60,000 heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Spanish Med at $13.25/13.50.

Some believe Glencore may have fixed the 1974-built Arnaki 81,881 dwt for this business on timecharter at $10,000 daily plus $180,000 bonus. Eleni 73,000 dwt was thought to have been taken by D'amato for grain, also from U.S. Gulf to Spain.
Reports of U.S. Gulf/Japan fixtures were hard to clarify. It seems likely that $25.75 no combo has been fixed for mid March on subjects (down 25 cents from yesterday).

But there were also reports that Halla took a Cargill vessel on subjects at no less than $26.00 no combo for March 1/15, and Yukong was linked with Halla tonnage for similar dates at a stronger $26.50 no combo.

Shipmair were the charterers associated by brokers with the firm fixture of the 1973-built Schubert 61,767 dwt delivery prompt La Coruna for an EC south American round redelivery Continent at $9,500 daily.

In the samller sizes Cargill was said to be closely working 43,000 heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Brest for Feb 22/27 at $13.75, and booked Cleanthes for March shipment of 22,750 heavy grain Plate/Cape Town at $21.00. A stronger fixture of about 25/30,000 pellets Paranagua/Continent than Evpo Agsa at $21.25 reported yesterday was understood to have been completed. Tradigrain fixed about 30,000 grains up River Plate and Brazil/Poland for Feb/March and 24,000 soyabeanmeal U.S. Gulf/Ireland for prompt loading, both on private terms.
Dreyfus was said to be still in the market for 28/30,000 soyabeans Baltimore/Spanish Med at about $11.75/12.00.

In the east Halla was linked with Merchant Pioneer 69,763 dwt for a Nopac round in the high $11,000's but the 1977-built Suerte 55,740 dwt failed on subjects with Metalink delivery prompt S.Korea for a trip via Nopac to Bin Qasim at $10,500 daily.

MINERALS - A number of capers have been fixed on subjects in a generally soft market. Courageous 149,190 dwt open Cape Passero mid March (trip Far East), Anangel Splendour 161,643 dwt open Chiba end March (possibly to BHP Australia/Continent), and Lowlands Rose 170,000 dwt open Japan March 10 (possibly to Bocimar).
Kleimar fixed Comanche 162,800 dwt for ironore Tubarao/China at $9.60 on subjects.

China coke business to the Continent was fixed by Goldbeam with National Prestige 75,100 dwt at a reported $9,000 daily, but HMM failed with Mavi for 40,000 coke Xingang/Continent for end Feb at $15.75.
